specificationNote: This is a provisional catalogue. Age guidance, build times, assembled dimensions and weights are sample estimates awaiting product validation. Set descriptions describe the proposed designs.

products.name: Chandrayaan-3
products.description: Build Vikram, Pragyan and a piece of the lunar surface. A display model with moving parts and a mission worth understanding.

build.title: A landing worth building.
build.text: Build the Vikram lander, Pragyan rover and a cratered lunar base with a printed nameplate.

details.title: Every part has a purpose.
details.text: Discover the instruments that helped the mission land, explore and learn.

process.title: Build it. Then understand it.
process.text: Numbered bags, a printed building guide and an illustrated mission story book help you make sense of what you make.

display.title: A little space for the Moon.
display.text: A black-edged lunar base frames the lander and rover as one complete scene.

products.imageAlt: The gold brick Vikram lander and Pragyan rover on a lunar display base.

products.name: Ram Mandir
products.subtitle: Ayodhya
products.dimensions: About 38 cm wide, 34 cm deep and 26 cm tall with the flag
products.imageAlt: The brick Ram Mandir seen from the front, on its base with four lawns
products.description: Build the temple hall by hall, from the first step to the flag. A small window in the roof sends a beam of light into the sanctum.

build.title: Walk in from the east.
build.text: The real temple faces the sunrise. The model is built in the same order.

details.title: The Surya Tilak window opens.
details.text: Tilt the small mirror tile on the third roof and a beam of light falls into the sanctum.

process.title: The spire lifts off.
process.text: Lift the spire to see the eight-sided sanctum inside.

display.title: Ayodhya
display.text: A simplified brick model inspired by the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.

products.name: Bharat: The Map of India
products.subtitle: 28 states · 8 union territories · 7 rivers
products.imageAlt: A square wall mosaic of India made of small round pieces, each state a different bright colour, in a brown frame.
products.description: Build India one dot at a time. Every state has its own colour, and every colour has a reason. When it is finished, it hangs on your wall.

build.title: Every dot is a piece. Tap the map.
build.text: Build India one dot at a time.

details.title: Seven rivers.
details.text: The rivers go on last: 109 blue tiles, laid on top of the finished states.

display.title: A door and a boat.
display.text: India never changes. The sea is yours.

products.name: Gully Cricket
products.subtitle: Your gully. Your rules.
products.imageAlt: A brick neighbourhood house with an open terrace, green shutters and four figures playing cricket in front.
products.description: Build a neighbourhood lane where the evening match never ends. Then take it apart and build it again: a narrow gully, a chai corner, a match-day pavilion, or something nobody has thought of yet.

details.title: Change the street.
details.text: One set. Build one at a time.

products.name: Yellow Taxi
products.subtitle: Calcutta · 1962
products.imageAlt: A yellow brick taxi with a blue stripe, luggage on the roof and marigolds on the grille.
products.description: Build the taxi that carried Calcutta for more than sixty years. The roof lifts off, the bonnet opens and the wheels roll.

build.title: Taxi!
build.text: Your model carries the year on its plate: WBT 1962.

details.title: Get in.
details.text: Lift the roof off and look inside.

process.title: Where to?
process.text: Britain built this design for three years. India built it for fifty-seven.

display.title: Last stop.
display.text: Soon there will be none left to hail. You can still build one.

products.name: Ulta Chashma
products.dimensions: About 15 cm wide, 17 cm deep and 11 cm tall. Life-size.
products.imageAlt: Blue brick glasses on a black display stand.
products.description: Tension toh hai sabke saath, bas nazariye ki hi toh hai baat.
